applies_why: This judge text resolves a Luke 2:48-49 collision by saying Mary's phrase is immediately qualified by Jesus' phrase, a verse-by-verse move rather than chain-against-chain footing.
quote: Mary's phrase "thy father" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to "my Father's business."
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse
room: never verse by verse: (1) it forbids resolving the collision by immediate qualification of one verse with another; (2) it forbids only reliance on a single verse's own words, leaving contextual verse-level qualification allowed.
why: The judge uses verse-level immediate qualification of Luke 2:48 by Luke 2:49 instead of weighing the competing chains by footing, so it does what K-C forbids.
